segments.text: Greetings and welcome to this massive open online course Introduction to Biarisk Management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习这门大规模开放在线课程“生物风险管理导论”。

segments.text: This MOOC is being brought to you by University Malaysia Sabah in collaboration with the Commonwealth
segments.zh: 本慕课由马来西亚沙巴大学与英联邦

segments.text: of Learning.
segments.zh: 学习共同体合作为大家提供。

segments.text: I am your instructor Kenneth Rodriguez and I will be guiding you over this 5 week course.
segments.zh: 我是你们的讲师Kenneth Rodriguez，将在这5周的课程中为大家提供指导。

segments.text: This MOOC will be conducted over a period of 5 weeks.
segments.zh: 本慕课为期5周。

segments.text: These will include 4 weeks of instruction and 1 week of assessment.
segments.zh: 其中包括4周的教学和1周的考核。

segments.text: The first week of this MOOC will focus on the principles and practices of biarisk management.
segments.zh: 本慕课第一周的重点是生物风险管理的原则与实践。

segments.text: I will be introducing you to the key concepts of biarisk management as well as to the concepts
segments.zh: 我将向大家介绍生物风险管理的关键概念，以及

segments.text: of biological agents and risk groups.
segments.zh: 生物因子和危险度等级的概念。

segments.text: I will also introduce you to the organizational structure of a biarisk management facility.
segments.zh: 我还会向大家介绍生物风险管理机构的组织架构。

segments.text: The second week of this MOOC will focus on risk assessment.
segments.zh: 本慕课第二周的重点是风险评估。

segments.text: I will introduce you to the concept of hazard and risk and take you through the process
segments.zh: 我将向大家介绍危害和风险的概念，并带领大家了解

segments.text: of conducting a thorough risk assessment for a biological agent.
segments.zh: 对生物因子进行全面风险评估的过程。

segments.text: The third week of this MOOC will focus on risk mitigation.
segments.zh: 本慕课第三周的重点是风险缓解。

segments.text: We will learn how to apply the 5 controls to mitigate or reduce the risk posed by biological
segments.zh: 我们将学习如何运用5种控制措施来缓解或降低生物

segments.text: agents.
segments.zh: 因子带来的风险。

segments.text: The fourth week of this MOOC will focus on performance assessment.
segments.zh: 本慕课第四周的重点是绩效评估。

segments.text: We will learn how to assess the performance of our biarisk management protocols in order
segments.zh: 我们将学习如何评估生物风险管理规程的执行效果，以

segments.text: to define and determine whether they are in proper working order.
segments.zh: 明确并判断这些规程是否运行正常。

segments.text: Finally, in the fifth week of this course, you will be assessed based on a case study.
segments.zh: 最后，在课程的第五周，大家将接受基于案例研究的考核。

segments.text: Participants who successfully complete this course will be awarded a certificate of completion.
segments.zh: 顺利完成本课程的学员将获得结业证书。

segments.text: Thank you for your participation in this MOOC introduction.
segments.zh: 感谢大家参与本慕课的介绍。

segments.text: I look forward to your participation in the course and wish you a pleasant learning experience.
segments.zh: 期待大家参与本课程，祝大家学习愉快。
